subject: Bounded accepted-1995 normal-combat gate-to-fence original-client attempt
setup: Recovered compatibility client 1.16.5.0 and disposable deployed-derived Game/world copy. Character started with mission 1995 already accepted at (93.2,115.0,137.5). The controller used the exact successful gate movement/aim/fire holds from the first prefix run without manual screenshot review.

Seven normal rifle hits of 106 damage killed gate placement 198674. The copied character gained 71 XP and 10 credits, objective 2 remained active, and the client survived.

observations.finding: After the post-gate turns and ordinary movement, client reached approximately (-8.3,97.9,124.3), already west of the fence. This differs from run 1 at the corresponding command-stage checkpoint (12.3,106.5,124.6). The movement/turn holds are identical, but run 1 interleaved read-only /loc chat toggles and captures.

observations.uncertainty: Display rounded to 0.1 m; input/path between screenshots unobserved.
observations.finding: Applying the run-1 D3.6s and W5s from the different fence starting point moved to (-20.1,97.9,145.4) and then (-43.6,98.5,132.1), inside an original map structure. Further W+A5s barely moved to (-43.4,98.5,131.9). The client was alive with objective 2 still active.

The harness focus classifier returned ui_mode and withheld the next move, with health pixel (151,0,0) and 395 bright pixels in its top-label crop. The screenshot shows indoor geometry and an overhead orange lamp in that crop; no UI MODE header or wounded-soldier dialogue is visible. This is an indoor-lamp false positive in the research harness, not an emulator mission failure.

Runner exited 0 and the copied char DB was restored byte-for-byte to baseline SHA-256 c5e103ae4b3ba945a0925784b62eb144ebebb124b4eb4a3348a56cb9eb60b705. Mission 1995 objective 2 was still active at stop.

assessment: The normal gate fight was reproduced in one client session, but a position-dependent fence route diverged and the run stopped inside an original structure. No outpost engagement, wounded-soldier conversation or Conrad use occurred. The divergence and false positive are controller/harness findings; they do not prove a final-live gameplay defect.
